items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Ibrahim. ... [INTERVIEWER] "...Ibrahim and the Mother Hagar" -- which is a Biblical thing, you know. We are descendants of that.

ctx.x: They had an identification card that read... I remember Rudy Powell's card that read "I am a descendant of the Father Abraham..."
"...Ibrahim and the Mother Hagar" -- which is a Biblical thing, you know. We are descendants of that. "And the son of Ishmael." It was on the card.
